description: The HR-79 RTO is the designated Registering Authority (SDM office) for the Kharkhoda sub-division in Haryana. It primarily handles the registration of non-transport (private) vehicles and the issuance of learner's and permanent driving licenses. Located in the Sonipat district, it serves a critical role in the transport administrative framework of the National Capital Region.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Kharkhoda, District Sonipat, Haryana
